picks.editorial_note: A combined $1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university-led AI investments of the year, aiming to anchor Georgia as a national AI hub and reshape the state's job market.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 15 universities across 10 states pooling supercomputing resources signals a major federal push to decentralize AI compute capacity beyond Big Tech and a handful of elite labs.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC leading a DOE Genesis Mission project to use AI for autonomous discovery in catalysis could accelerate breakthroughs in clean energy chemistry, reflecting the government's growing bet on AI-driven 'self-driving' science.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project to build fully autonomous, AI-agent-run laboratories represents a genuine shift in how experimental science could be conducted, removing humans from day-to-day experiment execution.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Phase II DOE Genesis Mission funding for Berkeley Lab's AI-driven particle accelerator design work shows sustained federal commitment to applying AI to fundamental physics infrastructure.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two new DOE Genesis Mission awards for AI-driven microelectronics and quantum information research extend the national lab system's expanding role as a testbed for AI applied to next-generation computing hardware.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: A $30 million NSF center spanning Indiana, UT Austin, MIT, Tufts, Utah, and Yale to study human-robot co-adaptation marks a significant multi-institution bet on making robots safer and more effective partners for people.
picks.title: Luddy researchers join new $30 million NSF Center to shape the future of human-robot co-adaptation

picks.editorial_note: A prestigious NIH Director's Pioneer Award backing an AI-human discovery engine built on large language model agents could meaningfully speed biomedical research by automating hypothesis generation.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: A CWRU-trained entrepreneur's optical computing chips, which use light instead of electronic circuits, tackle one of AI's most pressing real-world constraints: the soaring energy cost of running large models.
picks.title: A CWRU entrepreneur studied invisibility cloaks. Now he’s working to cut AI’s energy use | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5 million commitment to Georgia Tech for AI-accessible scientific computing exemplifies a growing pattern of industry philanthropy directly funding academic AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery
